messages:
Emma Chen (CS Manager): quick kickoff thread for Galaxy Med onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and any immediate renewal/contract risk. propose a 30m sync tomorrow.
Priya Kaur (AE): thanks emma. quick heads up: procurement may delay PO by 3–4 weeks unless legal signs off fast. renewal risk flagged there :warning:
Lucas Martin (Galaxy PM): adding context — Dr. Ortega (clinical lead) and Nico (SRE) will join. primary goal: EHR integration + compliance checklist by end of pilot.
Rohan Desai (Customer Eng): tech notes — needs sandbox creds, API schema, and sample export. ETA for integration run-through = 2 dev days once creds live.
Maya Singh (Enablement): can run two 1-hr enablement sessions (admin + ops). suggested cadence: week 1: admin, week 2: ops + hands-on workshop.
Emma Chen (CS Manager): proposed success criteria (please ack owners):
- data flow validated between EHR -> Redwood API (owner: Rohan)
- 2 clinician users complete workflow in prod-like env (owner: Lucas)
- no critical regressions in latency/accuracy (owner: Emma)
- procurement & PO in signed status (owner: Priya)
Priya Kaur (AE): I’ll own procurement. already pinged finance and legal. will escalate if no PO in 10 business days.
Lucas Martin (Galaxy PM): will run clinician validation and capture feedback checklist. can we add a short feedback form? 5 q items.
Emma Chen (CS Manager): yes — Maya, can you draft a 5-question feedback survey for clinician workflow capture? owner: Maya
Maya Singh (Enablement): on it. draft by EOD today, will share here. :thumbsup:
Rohan Desai (Customer Eng): for sandbox creds — @Priya can you confirm SSO or service account preference? If SSO, send IdP metadata.
Priya Kaur (AE): Galaxy wants service account for initial dev. I’ll DM the token and contact for Nico.
CS-Notify (bot): calendar invite created: Galaxy Med Onboarding Kickoff — tomorrow 10:30AM PT — attendees: Emma, Priya, Rohan, Lucas, Dr. Ortega, Nico, Maya. Invite link: https://calendar.example.com/evt/1781122334
Emma Chen (CS Manager): perfect. quick timeline block for visibility:
```
Week0: kickoff + enablement admin
Week1: sandbox integration + first clinician tests
Week2: ops workshop + feedback collection
Week3: pilot review + go/no-go decision
```
If procurement slips >2w, we pivot to limited pilot with synthetic data (reduced scope) — FYI.
Lucas Martin (Galaxy PM): noted. will prepare clinician slots and confirm Dr. Ortega availability after invite.
Priya Kaur (AE): escalation plan if PO not signed in 10bd: 1) exec outreach 2) temporarily enable limited pilot (contract addendum). will prep docs.
Emma Chen (CS Manager): thanks team. action items recap: Priya -> procurement follow; Rohan -> sandbox setup; Maya -> feedback form + enablement plan; Lucas -> clinician slots + validation checklist; Emma -> pilot success metrics + SLOs. Please drop any blockers here before the call. :rocket:
Maya Singh (Enablement): dropping draft survey in thread in 30m.
Rohan Desai (Customer Eng): starting sandbox infra now, will post test creds once ready.
Priya Kaur (AE): posted PO template and next steps in DM to finance.
Emma Chen (CS Manager): thanks all — see you on the call. if anything urgent ping me directly. :handshake:
